sections.home.introBody.id.label: isi pengantar Beranda Indonesia
sections.home.introBody.id.default: Kami menilai posisi hukum bersama dampaknya pada keluarga, kepemilikan, reputasi, dan ruang gerak klien. Setiap keputusan dirancang agar tetap proporsional, dapat dijalankan, dan terjaga.

sections.home.introBody.en.label: English isi pengantar Beranda
sections.home.introBody.en.default: We assess legal position alongside its effect on family, ownership, reputation, and personal latitude. Each decision is designed to remain proportionate, executable, and protected.

description.id: Informasi dibatasi pada tim yang perlu mengetahui dan setiap langkah dinilai terhadap dampak privasi.
description.en: Information is limited to those who need to know, and every step is assessed for privacy impact.

description.id: Pilihan litigasi diuji terhadap aset, keluarga, bisnis, dan reputasi-bukan hanya peluang menang.
description.en: Litigation choices are tested against assets, family, business, and reputation-not only the prospects of winning.
